text:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a few UX/security nits in Compliance > Data retention while testing a customer tenant. Nothing 🚨 but some confusing labels and an accessibility contrast flag.

aj: Thanks — can you list them out or paste quick screenshots?

maria: Sure, quick notes: 1) The region selector label currently says "Region" but the dropdown mixes cloud region + data residency regions (e.g., "us-east-1 (residency)"). Customers get confused whether this affects routing or legal residency. 2) KMS section uses "Default key" in the UI but backend shows "alias/redwood-default" — we should surface "Key alias" or include ID tooltip. 3) Audit logs have copy like "Events stored for 90 days" — ambiguous whether this covers exports, snapshots, or just UI view. 4) Retention chips (30/90/365) have poor contrast on hover per a11y. 5) Keyboard focus skips the retention dropdown when tabbing from alerts.

sophie: Re: Region label — propose changing label to "Data residency / region" and adding a short help link: "What this changes" -> modal that clarifies routing vs legal residency. Keep it compact.

alex: On the KMS alias vs id thing — backend stores key ARN and alias; frontend currently maps to "Default key" when alias present. We should show alias + a copyable key id under a small "Key details" expander. Low effort.

kevin: From security POV: make sure the "Key details" view warns that changing the key can re-encrypt or break past exports. Also clarify who can rotate keys (roles). Might need a tiny RBAC note.

aria: Accessibility notes: a11y-bot flagged contrast ratio for the retention chips at small sizes. Also the dropdown arrow is not reachable via Enter on some browsers. Repro steps: open Compliance > Data retention, Tab until you hit alerts, press Tab again — you jump into the footer.

a11y-bot: Automated check: retention-chip-hover: contrast ratio 2.7:1 (fail). focus-order: probable skip between alerts and retention-dropdown. Recommend tabindex audit.

aj: These are great. Can we triage? Suggest priority: 1) copy clarity for Region + Audit log copy (kevin + sophie), 2) KMS alias visibility (alex), 3) a11y fixes (aria).

maria: I'll attach a screenshot and a short recording in a follow-up message. For copy suggestions: propose audit text "Audit logs (includes API calls, config changes). Stored for 90 days; exportable via CSV." Thoughts?

sophie: Slight tweak: "Audit logs (API calls, config changes, and admin actions). Stored for 90 days. Exports are available; consult retention policy for long-term storage options." Keeps it clear without legalese.

kevin: Good. Add a line: "Access to exports is governed by your org's roles and audit policies. Contact your admin."

alex: I'll add the alias + key-id expander in the next sprint. ETA: end of week PR for frontend; need a tiny backend endpoint to return key metadata (should be quick).

aria: I'll pick up the tabindex and contrast tokens this sprint. Will run axe on the updated panel and post results.

maria: Thanks team. Who will own the copy PR? (sophie?) Also, please tag the docs team once copy is finalized.

sophie: Happy to own copy PR. I'll open a tiny branch and ping docs.

aj: I'll add this to the roadmap board and mark action items: copy(sophie), frontend(alex), a11y(aria), security notes(kevin).

maria: Perfect. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: Quick follow-up: anyone seen customers expecting KMS alias to be editable from UI? We've had a few asks to create keys from console. If that's in scope we should note as new feature request.

alex: Not in this change — feature request acknowledged. I'll file an issue and link it in the PR.

maria: Uploaded the screenshot and a 20s video showing tab skip. See link: https://redwood-internal/links/retention-ux-vid (internal).

a11y-bot: Reminder: after changes, run the automated regression suite and include results in PR description.

aj: cool — closing out here. We have owners and next steps.
